name: ROOTER EXPRESS OF JAX LLC
address_source: Public address confirmed independently across multiple directories with matching lat/long: MapQuest (Rooter Express Of Jax, 11648 Pine Acres Rd, Jacksonville, FL 32223), Yelp business listing, DispatchCore directory, BrightPath Contractor directory, Nextdoor business page (listed as '11648 Pine Acres Rd 36, Jacksonville, FL 32223'), and a prior Google Maps data pull for the same place id (lat 30.1611266, lng -81.6118776, which is inside the 32223 area). Used in JSON-LD, footer and a live Google Maps iframe embed since this is corroborated public information, not a service-area-only listing.
email_source: Found on the business's public Nextdoor page ('ROOTER EXPRESS OF JAX LLC', Jacksonville, FL) during deep research. Single source only: could not cross-confirm on Google Business, Thumbtack, Angi or HomeAdvisor (those pages either do not expose an email or returned 403/blocked on fetch). The double 'x' in 'jaxx' is exactly as listed; flagging it because it is an unusual spelling worth a human glance before sending.
own_site_check_result: IMPORTANT NUANCE: the domain rooterexpressofjax.com IS registered (resolves via DNS to Google Domains/Cloud infrastructure, 216.239.x.21) and was listed as the business's website on its Nextdoor profile. However, both the bare domain and the www subdomain return a bare Google-infrastructure 404 'Error 404 (Not Found)!!1' page (server: ESF) with zero business content, not a parked-domain ad page and not a real site. There is nothing to migrate away from and no live content a visitor could find. Treated as has_own_site: false per pipeline intent (no functioning public website exists today), but this is worth mentioning in outreach: they already bought the domain but never built anything on it. No website found in general web search either; Google Maps/Google Business shows no website button (verified by the requesting task before this build started). Thumbtack, Angi, HomeAdvisor and Facebook profiles are third-party directories, not an owned site, and none of them link to a different live domain.
rating_source: Given directly in the task brief as verified by direct inspection of the Google Maps listing (no 'Website' button present). Third-party directories show their own divergent counts from their own review pools (Angi ~4.6/95, HomeAdvisor 4.64/95 approved pro, DispatchCore 5/118, a web-search synthesis mentioned '5.0/61 Google' from an unverified aggregator), which is normal since each platform aggregates a different review pool; the Google Maps figure (5.0 / 182) is treated as the authoritative one for the hero, strip, JSON-LD and footer, per the task's explicit verification.

hours.source: Corroborated independently by three unaffiliated directories: Yelp ('Updated ... Open 24 hours'), Yahoo Local, and MapQuest, plus the business's own Nextdoor 'Our story' text ('sewer and drain cleaning for residential and commercial customers, available 24/7'). Not from Google Business hours directly (not independently re-checked by this build), but consistent across 3+ independent third-party sources.

review_sourcing_note: These are the best available verbatim, named quotes this build could access. Google Maps reviews themselves require a JS-rendered page this environment could not load (no browser/computer-use tool available), and Angi/HomeAdvisor/Yelp/Thumbtack all returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch (Cloudflare-style bot protection). Nextdoor's public business page rendered as plain text and exposed named, dated, verbatim recommendations, so it was used instead. A technician named 'Julian' (full name 'Julian Laca' per one reviewer) is mentioned repeatedly across Nextdoor, Angi and HomeAdvisor search summaries as the person customers deal with directly.
services_source: No published price list found anywhere (HomeAdvisor/Angi/Thumbtack listings do not expose a menu; Nextdoor 'Our story' only describes the business in general terms). Service categories below are synthesized from: (1) the 7 real job photos downloaded from this business's own Google Business Profile gallery (toilet drain snaking, a completed toilet install, a commercial flush-valve toilet, a bathroom sink fixture, an AO Smith electric water heater install, a Rheem water heater + water softener install, and a sewer-line power-rodding machine at a commercial curb with the company van visible), (2) HomeAdvisor's listed categories (plumbing inspection, backflow preventer install/replace, free onsite estimates), (3) Angi's listed categories (drain clearing, emergency service, warranties), and (4) Nextdoor's business description ('sewer and drain cleaning for residential and commercial customers'). Adapted variant per PIPELINE.md: no exact pricing is shown anywhere on the site, every service card ends in 'Ask about it' / call-to-quote, matching the real 'free onsite estimate' model found on HomeAdvisor.

photos.source: Google Business Profile photo gallery, originally downloaded in an earlier session (Nov 14) via curl with a Chrome user agent to output/rooter-express-of-jax-llc/assets/raw/. Those original lh3.googleusercontent.com URLs have since expired (return 403 when re-fetched today), so this build reused the 9 already-downloaded local JPEGs, verified each visually (not just by filename), discarded 2 for quality (a near-duplicate burst frame of the hero shot, and a dark/blurry under-sink pipe close-up), re-encoded the remaining 7 to max 1000px wide at quality 82, and copied them into this build's assets/raw/.

template_base: output/wash-wizards-services-llc/index.html (dark, bilingual, current-gate-passing skeleton; itself derived from the Mizu dark ejemplar pattern in templates/dark). Chosen over templates/dark/index.html directly because the raw templates/dark and templates/light ejemplars predate the mandatory bilingual (data-es/data-en + per-site isolated localStorage key) system that DESIGN.md and scripts/gate.py now require; this wash-wizards build already implements that correctly and passes the current gate.py unmodified.
build_variant: Adapted variant per PIPELINE.md Fase 3 point 5: no exact pricing (every service ends in 'Ask about it' / call for a free estimate, matching HomeAdvisor's listed free-onsite-estimate model), CTA to the real phone channel (call + text), bilingual EN default (data-es/data-en throughout) since the business operates in English. The confirmed public street address made a REAL Google Maps iframe embed possible in the location section instead of a photo placeholder, since this business's address is independently corroborated across 5 public directories (stronger case than a typical unlisted/service-area business).
palette: Custom steel/teal-blue dark palette (accent-deep #2f9ac2, accent-mid #3f87a6) derived for a plumbing trade on a dark base, since no existing brand colors/logo were found anywhere (no own website, no Instagram, no Facebook). The merktop-badge in the footer was protected during the palette swap and stays gold per the design system rule.
notes: A stale, lower-quality automated draft of this same business already existed at output/rooter-express-of-jax-llc/ (built 2026-11-14) with no real review quotes, a generic 'Plumbing' caption repeated on every gallery tile, and em-dashes in its dm_message (forbidden by PIPELINE.md). This build replaces it at the new slug 'rooter-express-of-jax' with real Nextdoor-sourced review quotes, distinct photo captions, a corrected palette, a real map embed, and a gate-passing bilingual implementation. The old rooter-express-of-jax-llc/ folder was left untouched (not deleted) since deleting/overwriting other output is outside this task's scope; a future cleanup pass should decide whether to remove the stale duplicate from data/processed.json consideration so only 'rooter-express-of-jax' gets registered.
